❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the SI unit of torque?

The newton-meter (N·m): one newton of force applied at one meter from the pivot.

How many foot-pounds are in a newton-meter?

1 N·m = 0.73756215 ft·lbf. Conversely, 1 ft·lbf = 1.35581795 N·m.

Is torque the same as energy?

They share units (N·m = joule) but are different quantities: torque is a rotational force, energy is work done. They must never be interchanged.
